notes.title: Mouse sensitivity control added!!
notes.content:
Hello Again,

As promised and once again, we are thrilled to announce an update for the original "Beach Head 2000" game, enabling mouse sensitivity controls for a more tailored and authentic experience, reminiscent of the original. We took the time to do this with pleasure, recognizing the joy it brings with its brilliant simplicity. 

Upon launching the game, you'll notice a newly introduced mouse sensitivity slider. This feature intelligently adapts to your Windows settings, offering a personalized and refined gaming experience. To mitigate any potential issues with excessive mouse speed, we've established a conservative default that closely mirrors the original settings on most systems. For those seeking a more customized touch, feel free to adjust the settings to match your preferences. It's important to note that while the default aligns with the original, minor adjustments may be needed based on your system for an optimal gaming feel.

We sincerely apologize for not giving these classic old games the attention and time they deserve earlier. As a small team with limited resources, we couldn't attend to everything, but we are committed to staying and providing you with the support you need now. Your feedback is invaluable and plays a crucial role in improving the gaming experience for everyone.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

notes.title: Windows 10+ Compatibility Fixed!!
notes.content:
Hello Everybody.

We're thrilled to share that we've resolved the compatibility issues, and the game should now work seamlessly on Windows 10-11. Could you please give it a try and let us know if it works for you?

If you encounter high mouse sensitivity, you can adjust it in your computer's mouse settings. We're also working on a launcher that will automate sensitivity adjustments for the proper experience. If you come across any visual glitches or have further questions, please reach out to our support team.

We sincerely apologize for not giving these classic old games the attention and time they deserve earlier. As a small team with limited resources, we couldn't attend to everything, but we are committed to staying and providing you with the support you need now. Your feedback is invaluable and plays a crucial role in improving the gaming experience for everyone.

Thank you for your understanding and continued support.

notes.title: Calling all Beachhead Fans!
notes.content:
Get ready to hop back into your gunner seat as the next iteration of the Beachhead series returns with a vengeance in Beachhead 2020. The Enemy is at the gates and there’s no time to waste, we either
fight-back or we slip-back into the dark-ages and start all over again. This is not your ordinary game or graphic novel, BH 2020 is a highly immersive, time-continuous multifaceted virtual reality experience that blends the best of both worlds and brings about an entire new dimension of interactive entertainment. For a complete list of features and all the latest BH:2020 news please take a look at our website www.digitalfusiongames.com/beachhead-2020. We are going to have a BeachHead Contest as well with dozens of unique & collectable prizes and the official announcements of the rewards for the contest will be in the upcoming weeks so, be sure to like our facebook pages
https://www.facebook.com/digitalfusionentertainment/ and
https://www.facebook.com/beachhead2020/ and sign up for the contest on
the BeachHead:2020 page on our website.
